Marta —

Appreciate the prompt review and the SOW redlines. Quick read below and proposed commitments:

- SLA request: we can agree to 99.5% for the first 90 days if we include an operational readiness checklist in the MAP (we've added a bulleted checklist in MAP_Novabio_v3).
- SOC 2: Ben will attach the SOC 2 Type II package for procurement.
- Billing contact: Priyom (cc’d) will be the billing point and will supply a PO number/contacts by EOD Monday if Novabio confirms the sign window.
- Fallback model variant: we will auto-route traffic to the quantized gpt-3.5-lr variant that preserves accuracy within the eval threshold (details in the MAP appendix). Latency improves by ~30% but heavy tails can see slight quality drift; we’ll map regressions to your eval prompts before go-live.

Proposed signature cadence (we can compress if Novabio signs faster):
- DocuSign send on 2026-08-25 09:00 PT
- Signer window: 48 hours (8/25–8/27)
- Target onboarding: 2026-09-01 (if signature completed within window)
- Alternate onboarding: 2026-09-08 (if signature after 8/27)

Ben — can you confirm the fallback clause language and that SOC 2 bundle is ready for procurement?

Thanks — I’ll hold the AV and onboarding slots pending Priyom’s billing confirmation.

—Karthik
